configuration.pmxt_routing: PMXT_V1 before 2026-04-13T20:00:00Z, PMXT_V2 from then; 2026-04-13T19 is spliced: V1-preferred / V2-only supplementation (V1 supplies book evidence for every token or condition it recorded; V2 supplies V2-only tokens and conditions from their real first observation, plus trade prints and tick-size changes)

evidence_grades.books/book_changes: PRICE_ONLY: per-level price_change deltas carrying post-change best bid/ask (L1). Same-millisecond ties have no recoverable order; not exact event replay
evidence_grades.books/depth_snapshots: BOOK_SNAPSHOT: full L2 depth as published in a venue book message; exact state at that observable time
evidence_grades.books/tick_size_changes: venue tick-size change notices (metadata, not replayed)
evidence_grades.books/trades: TRADE_FILL: venue last_trade_price prints delivered on the market channel
evidence_grades.fills: TRADE_FILL: on-chain fills (PolyLeviathan export), separate evidence stream

identity_exclusions.question: Will Fidesz-KDNP win at least 50 seats?

known_limitations: PendulumFlow classifies PMXT V1/V2 as snapshot grade: millisecond receive timestamps tie and the original exchange order within a tie is unrecoverable; archive export order is not stable. Ties are ordered deterministically by row content, which is arbitrary, and every ambiguous same-millisecond BBO group is counted in corpus_quality.json.
No stream is graded FULL_EVENT_REPLAY. Queue position, cancellation timing, maker fill probability and passive quote survival cannot be reconstructed.
observed_at is an archive-receive proxy, not a time at which this project possessed the data; recorder-to-venue latency is unknown.
PMXT V1 missed part of the live market universe (PendulumFlow documentation); selected markets absent from the archive are listed with book_available=false.
Coverage gaps are silence in the recorded stream and cannot be distinguished from genuinely quiet markets except by regime-wide silence statistics.
No state before a regime window is carried in; the first depth snapshot for each token arrives inside the window and BBO changes before it are counted.
BUILD-005 de-duplicates hashed trades on (token_id, transaction_hash); multiple venue trade prints sharing a transaction collapse to the first when replayed.
Fill price/size are source-supplied binary floats rendered as shortest round-trip text; fill side is exporter text and is not aggressor direction.

Splice hour 2026-04-13T19 (V1-preferred / V2-only): V1 supplies the book evidence of every token or condition it recorded; tokens only V2 recorded start at their first V2 observation (19:42:26.6) and have no state earlier in that hour. V2 trade prints and tick-size changes are kept for all tokens. Each row keeps its own source_version.

PMXT_V1.observed_at: HISTORICAL_PROXY_ARCHIVE_RECEIVE_TIME: PMXT V1 timestamp_received (ms); payload timestamp equals it to the millisecond (third-party recorder receive time)
PMXT_V1.source_timestamp: NULL: PMXT V1 carries no venue event time; timestamp_created_at is a later archive write time and is not used

PMXT_V2.observed_at: HISTORICAL_PROXY_ARCHIVE_RECEIVE_TIME: PMXT V2 timestamp_received (ms), when the archive's recorder received the message; used as observable time
PMXT_V2.source_timestamp: VENUE_EVENT_TIME: PMXT V2 timestamp (ms) from the Polymarket market channel; retained for diagnosis, never used for ordering

POLYLEVIATHAN_FILLS.observed_at: BLOCK_TIME_PROXY: equal to block time; no historical receipt time exists
POLYLEVIATHAN_FILLS.source_timestamp: BLOCK_TIME: on-chain block timestamp (1 s resolution)
